scientific_integrity: Analytical all-parameter proof, reproducible finite symbolic/numeric corroboration; heuristic original epidemic threshold separated from spectral theorem. Originality comparisons and residual risks documented.
scientific_limitations: Exact next-generation spectral local allocation theorem for equal-sized groups, symmetric equal-activity contacts, deterministic recurrent boosters, and exponential waning; no global minimizer, epidemic convergence, or fourth-order equality claim.
title: A sharp waning-dependent fairness reversal in disassortative booster allocation
